intendedAudience: Cozy-game players who enjoy small, visible acts of progress.
hypothesis: A simple planting loop with an immediate visual payoff will make Basil understandable without a feature explanation.
alternateHooks: A quiet minute in the shared garden.
I started with one empty row.

truthClaims.claim: Players can plant roses in Basil's Community Garden.
truthClaims.basis: Basil's production planting mechanic and rose plant definition.

truthClaims.claim: Basil is playable in a browser.

title: Planting one quiet row of roses
summary: Mary moves through an open patch and plants a rose at each stop, turning a sparse strip of garden into a small rose bed.
whyToday: This shows the most basic promise of Basil clearly: choose a place, plant something, and leave the garden visibly different.
narration: What can one rose change? Not much by itself, which is partly why I like planting one. You choose a quiet patch, place it, and move to the next open space. A row begins to take shape one small decision at a time. In Basil, that rose stays in the shared garden for the next person to find.
sourceNote: Founder narration grounded in Basil's real rose planting and shared Community Garden mechanics.
outroLine: Plant one for the next person.

youtube.headline: What can one rose change?
youtube.body: A small rose-planting loop in Basil's shared Community Garden. Pick an open patch, plant one, and leave the garden different for whoever arrives next.

instagram.headline: One quiet row of roses
instagram.body: I like that Basil's progress can be this small: choose a patch, plant one rose, and leave something behind for the next person.

reddit.headline: I planted a small row of roses in the shared garden
reddit.body: This is the simplest Basil loop: walk to an open patch, plant one rose, and keep going until the space has changed. I like the idea that somebody else can later come across the row. Would you keep it all roses or mix another flower into it?

beats.text: Choose a quiet patch and place it.
A row takes shape one small decision at a time.
The rose stays in the shared garden.
The next person may find it.
